title: Name fields the way people do

do.text: Label fields in plain words and give fixed lists their options, so a filter is a pick, not a guess.

dont.text: Don't show column names or ask people to type a value the field already knows.

title: Keep applied filters visible and undoable

do.text: Show each applied filter as a chip people can change or remove, with Clear all beside them.

dont.text: Don't lock a filter on without a way out: people see fewer rows and can't tell why.
